title: Send a text message
aliases: how do i send a text message
start a new message on my iphone

steps.instruction: Tap the pencil in a square icon for a new message.
Tap the matching person in the suggestions below "To:".
Type your message in the message box above the keyboard.
Tap the upward arrow beside your message to send it.

source_note: Messages on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Assumes Messages is set up and starts on the conversation list, with the recipient saved in Contacts. The message box placeholder and arrow colour vary between iMessage, RCS and SMS. Delivery depends on the available connection. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iph82fb73ba3/26/ios/26
